title: Witch on Crimson Bridge
description: A lone figure in a flowing green cloak and pointed hat stands atop a vibrant red bridge that stretches across a surreal landscape. To the left is an ancient stone tower covered in greenery, while the background features a massive glowing red celestial body, swirling cosmic patterns, and a starry sky above rolling green and yellow hills.
prompt: A solitary witch in a flowing emerald cloak and pointed hat stands on a dramatic red bridge that flows like lava across the scene. To the left, an ancient overgrown stone tower rises from lush greenery. A massive glowing red sun or planet dominates the sky behind her, surrounded by intricate cosmic circles, star maps, and swirling purple and magenta nebulae. The bridge has ornate blue and teal patterns. Surreal fantasy landscape with rolling green and yellow hills in the distance, mystical and otherworldly atmosphere, rich textures and bold colors.
